body:
### Description

Upgrade Synapse to v 1.80 using PIP leads to a broken installation. 

### Steps to reproduce

Have a previous version of Synapse installed like 1.79 using virtualenv and pip. Try and upgrade using normal PIP. 

Try running Synapse after upgrade and see following error. 

```
./bin/synctl --no-daemonize start" (uid: 5084 gid: 5084)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/apps/synapse/./bin/synctl", line 5, in <module>
    from synapse._scripts.synctl import main
  File "/apps/synapse/lib/python3.10/site-packages/synapse/__init__.py", line 24, in <module>
    from synapse.util.rust import check_rust_lib_up_to_date
  File "/apps/synapse/lib/python3.10/site-packages/synapse/util/rust.py", line 20, in <module>
    from synapse.synapse_rust import get_rust_file_digest
ImportError: /apps/synapse/lib/python3.10/site-packages/synapse/synapse_rust.abi3.so: invalid file format
```

### Homeserver

Several different personal homeservers. The upgrade fails consistently. 

### Synapse Version

1.79 upgraded to 1.80

### Installation Method

pip (from PyPI)

### Database

Postgres. Single server. No sqlite or backups involved. 

### Workers

Single process

### Platform

OS: Freebsd 13.1
Synapse was installed and upgraded many times in the same virtualenv environment. 

Initial installation
python3.11 -m venv /home/synapse
source /home/synapse/bin/activate
pip install "matrix-synapse[postgres]"

Typical upgrade
/home/synapse/bin/pip install --upgrade "matrix-synapse[postgres]"

Rust-1.68.0 is installed and available on server. 

### Configuration

It's a basic installation. No extra features. 

### Relevant log output

```shell
./bin/synctl --no-daemonize start" (uid: 5084 gid: 5084)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/apps/synapse/./bin/synctl", line 5, in <module>
    from synapse._scripts.synctl import main
  File "/apps/synapse/lib/python3.10/site-packages/synapse/__init__.py", line 24, in <module>
    from synapse.util.rust import check_rust_lib_up_to_date
  File "/apps/synapse/lib/python3.10/site-packages/synapse/util/rust.py", line 20, in <module>
    from synapse.synapse_rust import get_rust_file_digest
ImportError: /apps/synapse/lib/python3.10/site-packages/synapse/synapse_rust.abi3.so: invalid file format
```
```


### Anything else that would be useful to know?

I've tried doing a force reinstall of all the components using: pip install --upgrade --force-reinstall "matrix-synapse[postgres]"

The upgrade succeeds, bu the error persists.
